title: Rivet InputEnvelope
description: PROP-2026-0002 R4/R5: the one input shape of POST /v1/request and /v1/requests, WebSocket request frames (beside type and ref), the MCP rivet.request and rivet.sessions.open arguments, `rivet request --input FILE|-`, Runtime::call_json and the FFI. There is no `error` key. The 0.1.0 keys `id` and `params` are deprecated aliases through 0.2.x; sending a key together with its alias is validation.input_envelope. Unknown keys are ignored.

data.description: The operation's input (usually an object); default {}.

restrict.description: {grants:[…]} in the policy.json grant format; narrows this request only.

pretty.description: FFI only: indent the returned JSON.
